$description: Exception register. An exception lets named files break a named rule until it expires. tools/check.mjs honours live exceptions and fails once one has expired. Add one only through the exception process (governance/README.md#exceptions). An exception never silently becomes a standard.

exceptions.reason: Foundation v0.2 component styles carry legacy literals (white on feature fills, translucent overlays, a few pixel sizes inside components). They are reviewed and contrast-checked; each moves to a token in 1.1.
